steps.content:
15 Days
Until the Trial
You went down the hall to Demon's cell.
Several guards were waiting there.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: The evidence is ready. The suspect, Demon Schilder, is awake. You may start your interrogation.
You nodded to the staff, then took a deep breath as you faced the cell door.
The cell door was already open. Yet Demon wasn't inside.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Chief, watch out!
You sensed something was wrong. You spun around, only to face Demon's glaring eyes.
Before you could react, a searing pain enveloped your head. You blacked out and lost consciousness...
What are you doing?
Let go... Chief...
Put down the gun... let him pass...
You opened your eyes to a peeling ceiling. Your arms and legs were so tightly bound that you could not move an inch.
You groggily remembered what happened. You were planning to interrogate Demon in his cell, but he attacked you.
Demon was still dozing off in his chair. It seemed like he was exhausted from running away while injured.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: ...Awake?
Demon seemed to hear the sound of you struggling and opened his eyes. He brought you a glass of water.
You wanted to refuse, but your parched lips and dry throat thirsted for water.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: You're dehydrated.
Your parched lips throbbed in pain. You realized Demon was right and drank the cup.
After that, Demon fell silent again. It didn't seem like he was going to explain what was going on.
As you wriggled your body, you realized that your personal tracker was still on you. The Bureau would be able to track your location.
Demon heard your movement and squinted at you.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Don't move.
Demon's eyes were bloodshot. His voice was threatening, but also reeked of indescribable exhaustion.
He was in a fragile state. His usual threatening and ferocious demeanor had been stretched to the limit.

options: Ask him why he kidnapped you

choices.text: Ask him why he kidnapped you

steps.content: You've already achieved your goal and escaped from the Bureau. Why do you keep me around?
You want to kill me?
The dim light cast dark shadows over Demon.
After a long silence, his dry and ominous voice spoke up again.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: I can spare you...

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Don't get in the way of my revenge, and I'll let you go.
Revenge. It wasn't the first time Demon mentioned this word.

options: Who do you want to take revenge upon?

choices.text: Who do you want to take revenge upon?

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: You don't need to know...
Ding—
A sudden noise from the water pipe in the corner interrupted Demon. Probably some alarm was triggered. Demon stood up, high on alert.
People might be on their way to rescue you.
The people you want to exact revenge on, are they the deceased city councilors? What did they do?
Demon ignored you, walked across the room and opened the curtains. He peered out the window and quickly came back to you.
Did they frame you?

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Shut up.
Demon's facial muscles twitched slightly, but he didn't answer your question. Perhaps he was unsettled by the alarm and was planning to leave.
You should stall some more time for your rescuers.
Are you going to keep fleeing?
It's been eight years. You're killing more people and becoming more notorious. Yet nobody knows the truth. They only see you as a killer. They fear you, despise you...
Look at the situation you're in now. You're hiding left and right, running out of options... How much of your plan for revenge has been realized?

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Shut up!
Demon leaned down and grabbed you by the collar.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: You know nothing!
Then tell me what you want to do!
The anger that had been suppressed for eight years poured out.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: They must pay for Abel's death!
Are you saying that the City Council was responsible for Abel's death?

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Isn't it obvious?

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Eight years ago, Abel entered the election to repeal the Western District Security Law...

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Aside from those maggot councilors, who else had the motive to kill him?
Demon's face contorted from the murderous rage that had built up for many years.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: They bribed Finn, one of my former subordinates, to let thugs armed with Mania weapons into the venue.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Abel turned into a Corruptor, so I had no choice but to kill him. I had to kill... my father.
Demon's voice quivered when he uttered the word "father."

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: They scapegoated me for everything...

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: The most ridiculous thing was that everyone believed the City Council's words. Just because I'm from... the Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: In that case, I could only use the Syndicate's methods to resolve the problem...
Demon inched up close to you, spitting out each word with relish.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Everyone who had anything to do with this must die.
Demon finally released the rage that he had nowhere to vent for eight years.
He gasped for air after spitting out everything in one breath. His bloodshot eyes were filled with rage but also helplessness.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Help me?
Demon laughed coldly.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: How will you help me? Declare war on the City Council?
You're a Sinner from the Bureau. If what you said is true, I have the responsibility to protect you.
Only by staying alive can you bring the real culprits to justice. If you keep fleeing like this, you'll die sooner or later... It's not too late to come back to the Bureau with me.
Demon raised his head and took a deep gulp of air, gradually calming down.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: ...Eight years ago, perhaps I would've believed you.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: But not anymore.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: I know you're just stalling for time to wait for help. I won't give you any more chances.
You struggled to get up, trying to defend yourself.
As you wriggled and writhed, the bracelet you wanted to use for questioning slipped out of your pocket and fell to the ground.
Demon's pupils shrank abruptly. Though this was the second time he saw the bracelet, he still couldn't conceal how shaken he was by it.
You remembered the question you wanted to ask during the interrogation, as well as the question that came up when you were browsing the files.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: If your guess was correct, the bracelet given to you by the City Council belonged to her.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Abel's biological daughter, Demon's sister.
Vera Schilder
Demon looked at the bracelet on the ground in silence.
Is she important to you?

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: She is my family... my little sister.
Demon's expression gave the answer you were looking for.
He picked up the bracelet gently from the ground.
He raised his hand as dim rays of light shone through the curtains. The white bracelet swayed slightly. There was a gentle look on his face that you've never seen before.
Where is she?

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: I... don't know.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: I'm a fugitive, while she's a councilor's daughter. I can't go meet her.
As for the bracelet the City Council gave...

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: I can only think of one explanation. They kidnapped Vera to use her to threaten me.
Is that why you escaped the Bureau despite your injuries?

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Vera is the only family I have left... I must find her.
Demon clutched the bracelet in his palm and turned to you. His expression was unprecedentedly calm.

options: I will help you find her.

choices.text: I will help you find her.

steps.content: This time, Demon didn't refuse right away.
The Bureau has sufficient manpower and a well-developed intelligence network. Finding Vera won't be difficult as long as you can provide the appropriate information.
I'm not your enemy, Demon. Come back with me. You shouldn't shoulder all the burden by yourself.
Demon didn't respond. He just stared at you quietly.
Thankfully, the hostility had vanished from his eyes.
After a long time, Demon responded.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Thank you...
Demon walked to the window and opened the curtains. Blinding sunlight poured in from outside, and for a moment you couldn't open your eyes.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: I've met people like you. None of them survived.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Good people don't live long in DisCity, but murderers like me can survive until now.
Demon opened the window. A grassy breeze diluted the musty odor in the room.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: This is a battle I must fight alone.
Wait...

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: You have impressive men working for you. They will find you.
Demon leaned on the window sill. He covered his wound with one hand and gazed out the window.
Was he just going to leave like this? In his current state of health, it would only be a matter of time before he got caught.
You can't just leave like this! The City Council will sent their troops to arrest you. If you land in their hands...
You hadn't noticed that the old wooden door had been open for some time. A man in a hat stood by the door.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Man
steps.content: Cough...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Man
steps.content: Sorry, I didn't mean to interrupt your conversation.
You can't just leave like this! The City Council will sent their troops to arrest you. If you land in their hands...
You hadn't noticed that the old wooden door had been open for some time. A man in a hat stood by the door.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Man
steps.content: Cough...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Man
steps.content: Sorry, I didn't mean to interrupt your conversation.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: Who are you?!
Demon immediately became vigilant. He didn't notice the man's arrival either.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Man
steps.content: It doesn't matter who I am. What matters is what I heard. It seems that in fifteen days, a show trial will be held against you.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Man
steps.content: I have a plan to break the game... do you two want to hear it?
The man smiled faintly. He didn't wait for an answer, but took off his hat and walked in.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Man
steps.content: I think you do.
